title: halimium lasiocalycinum subsp. rhiphaeum
intro: Halimium lasiocalycinum subsp. rhiphaeum, commonly known as Rockrose, is a plant species in the Cistaceae family, characterized by its bright yellow or orange flowers. The health benefits of Halimium lasiocalycinum subsp. rhiphaeum include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help alleviate conditions such as arthritis and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to soothe skin irritations and reduce stress, making it a popular ingredient in herbal remedies and skincare products. The bioactive constituents of Halimium lasiocalycinum subsp. rhiphaeum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
